papers.title: Developing Realistic Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) Attack Dataset and Taxonomy
papers.venue: IEEE 53rd International Carnahan Conference on Security Technology (ICCST)
papers.architecture: Random Forest, ID3, Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression
papers.key_contribution: Introduced the modern CIC-DDoS2019 benchmark dataset with 12 reflection/exploitation DDoS attacks captured using CICFlowMeter.

papers.title: Advancing DDoS Attack Detection: A Synergistic Approach Using Deep Residual Neural Networks and Synthetic Oversampling
papers.key_contribution: Overcomes extreme flow-level class imbalance using synthetic minority oversampling paired with deep residual networks.

papers.title: DDoSDet: An approach to Detect DDoS attacks using Neural Networks
papers.architecture: Deep Multi-Layer Perceptron with Batch Normalization
papers.key_contribution: Demonstrated that normalized flow statistical representations allow lightweight neural nets to detect volumetric DDoS.

papers.title: An Efficient Real Time DDoS Detection Model Using Machine Learning Algorithms
papers.architecture: PCA Dimensionality Reduction + Random Forest & AdaBoost
papers.key_contribution: Reduces feature space to 15 principal components enabling real-time microsecond packet inspection.

papers.title: A Transformer-Based Approach for DDoS Attack Detection in IoT Networks
papers.key_contribution: Applies multi-head self-attention across sequential packet windows to detect IoT protocol DDoS (MQTT/CoAP).

papers.title: Feature Selection via GANs (GANFS): Enhancing Machine Learning Models for DDoS Mitigation
papers.key_contribution: Formulates feature selection as an adversarial minimax game to isolate the 18 most discriminative flow features.

papers.title: A GAN-Based Framework for Robust DDoS Attack Detection
papers.key_contribution: Defends against evasion perturbations (PGD/FGSM) by incorporating adversarial noise during neural network training.
